## Setup (5 steps)
1. Create a Google Sheet with a `snapshots` tab and headers:
`scraped_at | url | title | price | currency | in_stock | promo | rating | reviews_count`
2. Paste the Sheet ID into **Read snapshots** and **Append snapshots**.
3. Connect credentials: Google Sheets, Telegram, and OpenRouter (Header Auth: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <key>`).
4. Edit **Config**: `telegram_chat_id`, `llm_model` (OpenRouter model id), `send_if_no_changes`.
5. Import `error-workflow.json` and select it in Settings → Error workflow.

Demo source: books.toscrape.com (public scraping sandbox).

// Demo source: public scraping sandbox (books.toscrape.com).
// For a real client: replace with their product URLs (or read them from a sheet).
const base = 'https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/';
const slugs = [
  'a-light-in-the-attic_1000',
  'tipping-the-velvet_999',
  'soumission_998',
  'sharp-objects_997',
  'sapiens-a-brief-history-of-humankind_996',
  'the-requiem-red_995',
  'the-dirty-little-secrets-of-getting-your-dream-job_994',
  'the-coming-woman-a-novel-based-on-the-life-of-the-infamous-feminist-victoria-woodhull_993',
  'the-boys-in-the-boat-nine-americans-and-their-epic-quest-for-gold-at-the-1936-berlin-olympics_992',
  'the-black-maria_991',
  'starving-hearts-triangular-trade-trilogy-1_990',
  'shakespeares-sonnets_989',
  'set-me-free_988',
  'scott-pilgrims-precious-little-life-scott-pilgrim-1_987',
  'rip-it-up-and-start-again_986',
  'our-band-could-be-your-life-scenes-from-the-american-indie-underground-1981-1991_985',
  'olio_984',
  'mesaerion-the-best-science-fiction-stories-1800-1849_983',
  'libertarianism-for-beginners_982',
  'its-only-the-himalayas_981'
];
return slugs.map(s => ({ json: { url: base + s + '/index.html' } }));

// Turns the "rows" array into separate items for the Google Sheets append node.
return $json.rows.filter(r => !r.skip).map(r => ({ json: r.row }));
